                                                                                                                         4 years ago
                           glaze-making


                             This is a fluid base with titanium, which should produce flowing variegated glazes with
                        added colourants and/or in combination. All colourant tests shown are in addition to the
                                titanium. If you're not getting the phase separation and opacity, try a thicker application, a
                             cooler firing, or adding a little more titanium.


                                              If you use an immersion blender to mix your tests, you will need to use the same blender
                                 for the full batches, as it can have a drastic impact on the result with certain colourants
                              (including titanium)


                              I'm separating out the colour tests as I do them on larger pieces to make them easier to
                                   find:
